rules: Keep ingestion, global lexical source discovery, BM25 order, destination guard and current budgets unchanged.
For each lexical seed in existing order, consider at most its immediate preceding and following stored chunks in the same revision, preceding first, if not already represented.
Use exact contiguous source text including blank separators, never more than the existing 1200-byte normal chunk target for expansion. A larger original seed remains intact.
Return one immutable revision-bound window reference for each expanded span; retain old chunk references and validate every window against stored boundaries and source text.
Do not repeat any represented chunk. If an expanded window cannot fit remaining bytes, try the original seed, preserving explicit budget omissions.
No query-specific vocabulary, gold-derived settings, threshold sweeps, global full-document fallback, model calls or shared contract changes.
decision: Evaluate once on existing suites and independently frozen cases. Reject for unacceptable regression; no subsequent tuning against held-out cases.
